label: The published resolution ladder under-resolves fresh skills by 34 points: 58.2% vs 96.5% once file-relative, normpath and subtree-suffix stages are added. Corrected stage profile over 663 files / 4,384 tokens in 8 previously unsampled skills: file-relative 1,198; subtree-suffix 1,354; skill-root 808; repo-root 801; the two new stages carry 58% of resolutions, so the implementation spec must specify their semantics explicitly rather than copy iteration 9's ladder summary.

Residual after the corrected ladder is 153 tokens (3.5% of 4,384), all in enumerable expected families (scratch 58, placeholder/glob 26, runtime/generated 7, other 62) with four live drift candidates adjudicated: sk-design-diagram playbook cites create-diagram-auto.yaml and create-diagram-confirm.yaml which do not exist in the assets dir; council-graph playbooks cite schemas/tool-input-schemas.ts with no same-basename file under system-deep-loop; sk-git root playbook cites review_protocol.md and subagent_utilization_ledger.md absent repo-wide (watch-only, likely session artifacts); worktree-session.sh and worktree-reaper.sh resolve at .skilled/bin/ once global-basename runs.

Catalog line anchors are a 2-pack asset: full census over 29 feature-catalog packs / 611 files finds backticked path:line anchors only in system-spec-kit (22 anchor lines) and system-skill-advisor (10); the 22 freshly sampled packs carry 4,023 backticked path tokens and 1,480 markdown links with zero line anchors, so the catalog objective tier covers 2 of 29 packs and the other 27 need an existence/link tier if covered at all.

Extractor defect class #5 recorded: character-stripping relative tokens (lstrip of ./ destroys ../ prefixes) inflated the residual until os.path.normpath replaced it; the implementation spec must normpath relative tokens and pin a ../ regression fixture alongside the other four extractor defects observed across iterations 7-10.
